preheader: Stock futures edge higher after a heavy tech selloff, OpenAI pushes new terminology, and Eala hits a career high.

lead.headline: Stock futures bounce after a brutal five trillion dollar AI selloff
lead.body: U.S. stock futures edged higher ahead of a packed week featuring Apple earnings and the midterm elections. Markets are attempting to recover after a massive $5 trillion selloff hit technology and artificial intelligence stocks hard.
lead.why: When broad market sentiment swings like this, it directly impacts equity valuations and investor risk appetite. Keeping an eye on how tech giants weather these cash-burn concerns will help you understand current venture and public market dynamics.

stories.headline: In-N-Out hints at expanding to new states
stories.body: In-N-Out Burger president Lynsi Snyder suggested the iconic chain might expand its footprint into Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Mississippi. The potential geographic growth would bring the beloved California brand to new regional markets.
stories.why: Studying how a tightly controlled, private fast-food chain plans regional expansion gives you a practical framework for scaling physical operations without losing brand equity.

stories.headline: Toyota RAV4 sales slip despite strong consumer demand
stories.body: Toyota saw its popular RAV4 sales drop 29 percent in 2026 despite strong consumer demand. The dip stems from supply constraints rather than a lack of buyers looking for the compact SUV.
stories.why: This is a classic supply chain bottleneck case study, showing how inventory shortages can severely depress unit sales even when your product is wildly popular.

stories.headline: OpenAI wants to rebrand data centers as compute campuses
stories.body: OpenAI is pushing a new piece of corporate nomenclature, asking people to refer to traditional data centers as compute campuses. The company argues the new term better captures the massive scale, energy requirements, and workforce investments of these facilities.
stories.why: Corporate PR branding often shifts to manage public backlash over heavy infrastructure projects. It is a textbook example of how companies try to reshape public perception around industrial resource consumption.

stories.headline: Reddit considers requiring logins to block AI scrapers
stories.body: Reddit leadership revealed during an earnings call that the platform is considering requiring users to be logged in to view most content. The move aims to protect the site's vast repository of human discussions from aggressive AI scraping.
stories.why: Protecting proprietary data assets is becoming a core defensive strategy for platform businesses. This highlights how web-based business models must constantly adapt their access policies to counter data harvesting.

stories.headline: AI search tools outpace traditional engines in shopping choices
stories.body: A new McKinsey report shows that AI-powered search tools are heavily influencing consumer purchases. Nearly a third of shoppers using AI tools cite them as the top factor in their buying decisions.
stories.why: As consumer search behavior migrates from traditional engines to chat tools, brands must completely rethink how they handle digital marketing and customer acquisition strategies.

stories.headline: Singapore graduates face higher bar for entry-level tech roles
stories.body: Employers in Singapore are raising expectations for fresh graduates, shifting entry-level developers from writing routine code to auditing AI-generated drafts for security and logic. Companies now expect junior hires to act as critical quality gatekeepers.
stories.why: As AI handles basic execution tasks, your competitive edge in early career roles will rely heavily on your critical judgment, auditing skills, and ability to verify machine output.

stories.headline: Alex Eala rises to career-high ranking of No. 17
stories.body: Philippine tennis star Alex Eala climbed to a new career-high ranking of No. 17 with 2,289 total points. She enters the WTA 250 Hong Kong Open as her final tournament of the season.

stories.headline: Bianca Andreescu wins Queretaro Open singles title
stories.body: Canadian player Bianca Andreescu captured the Queretaro Open singles championship in Mexico. She overcame a second-set stumble to defeat top-seeded Tatjana Maria 6-1, 2-6, 6-3 in the final.

term.name: Yield Curve Management
term.definition: A central bank policy aimed at influencing specific interest points along the debt yield curve rather than just setting a single overnight rate. In today's news, Federal Reserve discussions highlight how managing these curves is tied directly to the rising costs of servicing national debt.

serve.headline: Braid raised $38 million to expand its mobile connectivity platform internationally
serve.body: Braid provides APIs that simplify mobile connectivity integration, allowing businesses to launch branded services quickly. The startup secured the funding after founder Jignesh Dave spent years navigating the high friction of launching traditional SIM card products.
